Your questions

Answers to questions

10 answers found

How do I arrange an appointment?+

Call 0308 6878587 to discuss a suitable date and time. Your appointment is confirmed directly by the clinic.

What are the treatment prices?+

Please contact the clinic for current consultation fees and an individual treatment estimate.

Which dental services can I ask about?+

Explore our service pages, then call the clinic to confirm availability and discuss your needs.

Can I arrange a remote consultation?+

Call the clinic to ask whether a remote conversation is available and appropriate for your enquiry.

Where is the clinic located?+

QRMV+52Q, Kharian Dinga Rd, Pindi Sultan Pur, Pakistan

Is the first consultation free?+

Please confirm consultation charges directly with the clinic when arranging your appointment.

What should I bring to my visit?+

Ask the clinic which previous records or other information to bring when arranging your appointment.

Can I arrange a family visit?+

Contact the clinic with the number of family members who would like an appointment and ask about suitable times.

How do I change my appointment?+

Please call the clinic directly to discuss a different time or cancel your appointment.

Does the website confirm my booking?+

The booking popup prepares a WhatsApp request for you to review and send. It does not reserve an appointment. The clinic must confirm your visit.
